question: An equilateral triangle has each side measuring 13 cm; find its perimeter.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

In an equilateral triangle, all three sides are equal in length.

Perimeter = 3 × side

Perimeter = 3 × 13 = 39 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 39 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Side of the equilateral triangle (a) = 13 cm

 

 A

 C
 13 cm
 13 cm
 13 cm

**Formula Used:**

Perimeter of a triangle = Sum of all its sides

**Calculation:**

⇒ Perimeter = a + a + a

⇒ Perimeter = 13 + 13 + 13

⇒ Perimeter = 39 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 39 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Area of Equilateral Triangle

The area is calculated using the formula: Area = (√3 ÷ 4) × a², where 'a' is the side of the triangle.

Height (Altitude) of Equilateral Triangle

The perpendicular distance from any vertex to the opposite side is given by: Height = (√3 ÷ 2) × a.

Inradius & Circumradius

The radius of the inscribed circle (Inradius) = a ÷ (2√3) and the radius of the circumscribed circle (Circumradius) = a ÷ √3.
